facts.summary: Non-exempt employees must be paid time-and-a-half for hours over 40 in a workweek. Federal law has no daily overtime.
facts.sourceAgency: U.S. Department of Labor, Wage and Hour Division

facts.summary: The executive/administrative/professional (EAP) exemption requires a salary of at least $684/week ($35,568/year), plus the salary-basis and duties tests.
facts.sourceAgency: U.S. Department of Labor, Wage and Hour Division
facts.notes: The 2024 final rule (raising to $844 then $1,128/wk) was vacated 2024-11-15 (E.D. Tex.). A technical amendment restored the 2019 $684 text, effective 2026-05-15. Confirm figure annually.

facts.summary: Highly compensated employees ($107,432/year+) are exempt under a relaxed duties test.
facts.sourceAgency: U.S. Department of Labor, Wage and Hour Division

facts.summary: Computer employees are exempt if paid at least $27.63/hour (or the salary level) and perform qualifying duties.
facts.sourceAgency: U.S. Department of Labor, Wage and Hour Division

facts.summary: Federal minimum wage is $7.25/hour. State or local minimums that are higher apply instead.
facts.sourceAgency: U.S. Department of Labor, Wage and Hour Division

value: sex (incl. pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity)
facts.summary: Federal law prohibits employment discrimination based on these protected characteristics.
facts.citation: 42 U.S.C. § 2000e-2 (Title VII); 29 U.S.C. § 623 (ADEA); 42 U.S.C. § 12112 (ADA); Bostock v. Clayton County (2020)

facts.summary: Title VII and the ADA cover employers with 15 or more employees; the ADEA covers employers with 20 or more.
Employers (15+) must provide reasonable accommodation for a known disability unless it causes undue hardship, and must engage in an interactive process. Medical info must be kept confidential.
It is illegal to retaliate against someone for reporting discrimination/harassment or otherwise engaging in protected activity, even if the underlying claim is not proven, if made in good faith.
Employees have the right to discuss wages and working conditions with coworkers; policies forbidding it are generally unenforceable.

A discrimination charge must be filed with the EEOC within 180 days, extended to 300 days where a state/local agency enforces a parallel law. Federal employees must contact an EEO Counselor within 45 days.
FLSA wage claims must generally be brought within 2 years, or 3 years for a willful violation.
facts.sourceAgency: U.S. Department of Labor, Wage and Hour Division

facts.summary: Equal Pay Act claims may be filed within 2 years (3 for willful) and do not require an EEOC charge first.
Eligible employees at employers with 50+ employees (within 75 miles) may take up to 12 weeks of unpaid, job-protected leave for qualifying family/medical reasons.
facts.sourceAgency: U.S. Department of Labor, Wage and Hour Division

facts.summary: For a valid waiver of age claims in severance, workers 40+ get at least 21 days to consider (45 in a group layoff) and 7 days to revoke after signing.
